description: FCF Canonical System Map — semantic source of truth. Spine re-based (2026-09-17) from the 「中鱼升级｜」 design branch (Mainline First-Principles / Causal Heritage): 中鱼升级 is the substrate, and each lower design level is a projection with strictly smaller scope. The previous v0.1 skeleton (which used Simplified V0's module chain as the spine) is superseded; it remains in git history at 2d52879 for provenance. generated/ is a build artifact — never hand-edit.

spine: 中鱼升级｜Overall System Model：从 World State 到 Fish Spawn Commit (v20, 2026-09-15)
中鱼升级｜Mechanism Topology V2：Spatial × Response 深入下钻 (v2, 2026-09-14)
中鱼升级｜Behavioral Regime × Largemouth Bass：Spatial–Response 中层逻辑样板 (v8, 2026-09-15)
provenance.superseded: FCF Simplified V0 / 0.3.4 module chain 4.0–4.7 was used as the v0.1 spine; it is a projection of this branch, not the substrate.

semantics.hierarchy: parent = progressive-disclosure grouping (collapsible domains). Hierarchy is NOT a dataflow claim; the causal flow is carried by the explicit edges below.
semantics.edges: DATA_FLOW (solid) | CONTROL_OR_SELECTION (dashed) | REFERENCE_OR_CONFIG (dotted, reserved) | RETENTION (the same-support L×C join) | ANCHOR (relationship fact handed to Interaction; explicitly NOT the final EnvironmentWeight)
semantics.joinRule: Join Before Reduce — L and C combine on the same identity/support BEFORE reducing over the Opportunity measure. q_species,j = Σ_r L_r,j × C_r,j
semantics.regimeAxis: Behavioral Regime is a presentation-independent upstream semantic, not a cross-domain owner. It materializes only when it must carry L_r ↔ C_r correlation, and normally dies after the join.
semantics.edgeRouting: exit/entry: N,S,E,W hints for the orthogonal router; purely visual and deterministic.
